The foreman {npc:Budrik} was robbed by the gang of {creature:The Horned Fox}: they took his 600-year-old miner's helmet that belonged to his father and grandfather. Recover it in a minotaur tower near the Dwarf Mines and Budrik gives you his spare helmet, a {item:Mining Helmet}. It also unlocks the Turmoil of War task.
When you return the helmet to {npc:Budrik}: you can now start this task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest}.
